title: 몸: 머리, 눈, 코, 입, 손, 발
objective: By the end, you can name ten basic body parts in Korean and say which one hurts with "___이/가 아파요."
summary: Learn ten basic body words and use them in short everyday sentences about health.

task.title: Use the body words
task.line: Write or choose the Korean body word for each item; use 이 after a word ending in a consonant (눈이) and 가 after a vowel (배가).

words.exampleMeaning: I have a bit of a headache. Do you have any medicine?
My nose is red because it's cold.
Open your mouth wide. (at the dentist)
My ear hurts, so I'm going to the doctor.
I wash my hands before I eat.
My legs hurt because I walked a lot.
My feet are cold. Do you have any socks?
I have a stomachache. Where is the restroom?

exercises: Write the Korean word: ① ear ② arm ③ stomach ④ head
Choose 이 or 가: ① 입(이 / 가) 아파요. ② 다리(이 / 가) 아파요. ③ 손(이 / 가) 아파요.

Which body part probably hurts? Write it in Korean: ① 음악을 너무 크게 들었어요. (I listened to music too loud.) ② 매운 음식을 많이 먹었어요. (I ate a lot of spicy food.) ③ 하루 종일 컴퓨터를 봤어요. (I looked at a computer all day.)
Which body part do you use? Write it in Korean: ① 꽃 냄새를 맡아요. (I smell flowers.) ② 축구를 해요. (I play soccer.) ③ 편지를 써요. (I write a letter.) ④ 노래를 해요. (I sing.)
A doctor asks you, "어디가 아파요?" Answer in Korean: ① Your arm hurts. ② Your foot hurts.
answers: ① 귀 ② 팔 ③ 배 ④ 머리
① 입이 ② 다리가 ③ 손이
① 귀 (also possible: 머리) ② 배 (also possible: 입) ③ 눈 (also possible: 머리)
① 코 ② 발 (also possible: 다리) ③ 손 ④ 입
① 팔이 아파요. ② 발이 아파요.
